PriMin

                                Latter assured him that aircraft intended as replacement aircraft

Farhadi
all pertinent details in near future.

told me he believes
                                King and others realize seriousness of Conte issue and fact that

                                investigate thoroughly and enforce law if facts so indicate. He,
                                therefore, expects full
RGA
cooperation although he has had some difficulties with Pri Min who

aid.
